Hi Jared — great to hear, and thanks for the clear list. Below are the items and next steps; I copied our sales ops and finance leads to help close the loop.

1) DPA (e-sign)
- DocuSign: https://docusign.com/sign/REDWOOD-DPA-2029-06 (click to review & sign).
- We typically ask for signature within 3 business days; if you need redlines, route them to legal@redwood.com and cc me so we can track.

2) SOC 2
- Read-only SOC 2 (Type II) link: https://status.redwood.ai/reports/soc2/2028-report.pdf
- Audit period: Sep 2027 – Aug 2028; last independent test date: 2028-09-15. If you need a bridge letter for an earlier cutoff, let us know.

3) Subprocessors
- Attached: redwood_subprocessors_202906.csv (production subprocessors, hosting, logging, analytics).
- Short attestation: Redwood Inference confirms subprocessors listed are current as of 2029-06-12. For EU customers we include standard SCCs in the DPA and will provide a count of transfers on request.

4) PO / billing routing
- Bill to: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- AP email (submit PO and invoice): ap@redwood.com
- Invoice remittance email (for invoice PDFs): billing@redwood.com
- Include Deal ID: MID-2029-0117 on the PO and invoices; payments are net 30 unless otherwise agreed.
- VAT: please provide Midline's VAT/Tax ID and billing address so we can validate.

5) Timing and contacts
- Expected turnaround if DPA is signed without redlines: 1–3 business days and then PO issuance from your side.
- If legal redlines are needed, have your counsel send a mark-up to legal@redwood.com — Ben (cc) will triage with our legal ops.

Resources / tracking
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/MID-2029-0117

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf (DPA copy for review), redwood_subprocessors_202906.csv

If you confirm the billing entity and VAT, I can start the DocuSign cascade and loop in finance for PO matching.

Best,

Sofia — thanks for the quick packet and links. A few quick clarifications before we route to procurement: 

- PO: Midline will issue the PO from "Midline LLC" (US entity). Our AP team needs the exact billing address and the Tax ID — I will send that in a follow-up.
- DPA signing: who at Redwood will be the signatory on the DocuSign? Our legal prefers to see a named signatory (title + name) rather than generic company sig. If your legal needs a business contact to accept service, let us know.
- Subprocessors: CSV looks good. Can you confirm whether Redwood uses any subprocessor for error reporting and analytics (e.g., Sentry, DataDog, Segment)? We need a one-paragraph attestation we can attach to the procurement file saying: "No additional subprocessors beyond the list, and all are bound by contract terms comparable to our DPA."

If you can provide the DPA signatory name and the short one-paragraph attestation, I can push the PO through today.

Thanks,
Jared
